_comment: Fictional titles for `make demo`, shaped like TMDB movie results. Listed in popularity order.

results.title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Ledger
results.overview: A retired accountant inherits a remote lighthouse and finds forty years of unpaid ship tolls in the logbook.

results.title: Paper Comets
results.overview: Two rival kite makers enter the same autumn festival and accidentally build something that flies too well.

results.title: Midnight at Quarry Lane
results.overview: A night-shift bus driver keeps picking up the same passenger, who never seems to get older.

results.title: Saltwater Accord
results.overview: Fishing towns on opposite shores negotiate the first treaty ever written for a single, very stubborn whale.

results.title: Orbit of Small Things
results.overview: A schoolteacher builds a homemade satellite to prove a point to her class and reaches further than planned.

results.title: The Clockmaker's Apprentice
results.overview: An apprentice in a mountain village learns that every clock he repairs moves the town's calendar by one day.

results.title: Glass Harbor
results.overview: A harbor master and a smuggler share one radio frequency through a winter that never seems to end.

results.title: Northbound Silence
results.overview: A long-distance train loses all sound for six hours, and the passengers learn to talk without it.

results.title: Copper and Fern
results.overview: A botanist and an electrician restore an abandoned greenhouse that powers itself in unexpected ways.

results.title: The Last Map of Verenna
results.overview: A cartographer is hired to map a city that redraws its own streets every night.

results.title: Lanterns Over Kessby
results.overview: When the power fails during a village wedding, the guests light the valley with whatever they can find.

results.title: A Quiet Riot of Bees
results.overview: A beekeeper's hives start following a teenage cyclist around town, to the alarm of everyone but her.

results.title: Under the Ninth Bridge
results.overview: Three siblings run a ferry under a bridge that was never finished and was never supposed to be.

results.title: Static Bloom
results.overview: A radio host discovers that a song she plays at 3 a.m. makes the city's streetlights flicker in rhythm.

results.title: The Orchard Conspiracy
results.overview: Neighbors in a sleepy orchard town suspect the apples are being swapped overnight. They are.

results.title: Winter Ledger
results.overview: An auditor snowed in at a mountain hotel reconciles the books and finds a guest who checked in in 1953.

results.title: Signal from Marrow Point
results.overview: A coastal radar station picks up a ship that left port a hundred years ago and is still asking for directions.

results.title: Gentle Machinery
results.overview: A factory robot slated for scrap is quietly adopted by the night cleaning crew.

results.title: The Weather Collector
results.overview: A shy meteorologist bottles unusual weather and sells it at a flea market, until a storm escapes.

results.title: Second Shift Symphony
results.overview: Hospital staff on the night shift form an orchestra from whatever instruments patients leave behind.

results.title: Atlas of Lost Umbrellas
results.overview: A lost-property clerk tries to return every umbrella in the station to its owner before he retires.

results.title: Red Kite Summer
results.overview: Two cousins track a pair of red kites across a dry summer and learn more about their grandfather than the birds.

results.title: Harborlight Express
results.overview: A night train becomes the only connection between two islands after a storm takes out the bridge.

results.title: Ink and Iron
results.overview: A blacksmith and a calligrapher are forced to share a workshop and, eventually, a signature style.

results.title: The Map Room
results.overview: Museum guards discover that one of the exhibits keeps updating itself with places that do not exist yet.

results.title: Elsewhere, Tuesday
results.overview: A woman wakes up every Tuesday in a different town and keeps a careful diary of the routes home.
